name: Go with golangci-lint
description: A Go application or module using standard Go checks and golangci-lint.

definitions.name: Purpose
definitions.defaultText: Build or maintain a Go application or module for the agreed user need. Define observable completion before editing.

definitions.name: Scope
definitions.defaultText: Change only the requested behavior and its needed tests. Preserve exported APIs and existing user work; ask before broad refactoring.

definitions.name: Architecture
definitions.defaultText: Follow the existing go.mod module and package boundaries. Keep business logic apart from transport, storage, and command entry points.

definitions.name: Dependencies
definitions.defaultText: Use existing modules where practical. Review go.mod and go.sum changes and explain new dependencies before adding them.

definitions.name: Quality
definitions.defaultText: Run gofmt, go vet ./..., and golangci-lint run with the repository configuration. Do not disable checks to make code pass; if golangci-lint is absent, report that before changing tooling.

definitions.name: Testing
definitions.defaultText: Add focused *_test.go cases for changed behavior and errors. Run go test ./...; use go test -race for relevant concurrent code when supported.

definitions.name: Proof
definitions.defaultText: Report the focused diff and actual formatting, vet, lint, and test results. Identify skipped checks and stop when the agreed behavior is verified.
